projects.name: Hennur Main Road Flyover (Nagawara–Kalyan Nagar)
projects.expectedCompletion: Long pending since 2012 due to land acquisition near Lingarajapuram; underpass portion (Nagawara–Kalyan Nagar) already complete
projects.description: Flyover on Hennur Main Road widened from 2 to 4 lanes and extended by 600m after resolving land acquisition (39.13 guntas, ~Rs 62 crore paid to landowners) and relocating a temple in Kacharakanahalli.

projects.name: Peripheral Ring Road / Bengaluru Business Corridor
projects.description: 73 km, 8-lane access-controlled expressway ringing outer Bengaluru from Tumkur Road (northwest) to Hosur Road (south) via Hessarghatta, Doddaballapur Road, Old Madras Road and Sarjapur Road. Includes 16 flyovers, 10 overpasses, 12 underpasses and bridges over 7 water bodies including Gunjur Lake. Meant to divert heavy commercial traffic off the Outer Ring Road.
